layer_scan.headline: **注入点处一阶预测精确成立，移出注入点即掉进噪声**：L=0…10 的 |实测/预测| 落在 0.0000–0.0939，且 think **逐层变号 4/8 次**、L=20 处与 no_think **异号**。⇒ **不存在「一个衰减倍数」**（硬取单点得 10.65（no_think L=8） / 41.80（think L=27） / 167.21（no_think L=27），极差 15.7 倍）。　⚠ 修订 65：这里原来写的是「17.9 / 29.9 / 228.5」，**前两个是 |实测/预测| 的比值乘了 1000**，而 228.5 复现不出来 ⇒ 已按定义重算并点出各自来自哪一档。`w·U[marker]` 应**在校准点读**：它给出方向在 unembedding 空间里指向什么；在中间层注入后读到的量**与它没有可预测的定量关系**。
layer_scan.calibration: L=-1 挂在 model.model.norm 的 **forward hook**（改输出），那里下游是恒等映射，Δlogit = α·(w·lm_head[token]) **精确成立**：预测 +41.8022，实测 think +41.2500（ratio 0.9868）、no_think +41.0000（ratio 0.9808）⇒ 钩子与公式都没错。　⚠ 修订 63：这几个数此前是**手打的**，而源产物里的 `pred_marker_lse` / `calibration_ratio` **没被带进产物** ⇒ 散文里的数在产物里查不到出处。现已把两个字段带进 `rows`，散文改为从它们派生。

steering_transfer.alpha_rule: 0.1 * measured block-20 input L2 norm at the last prefix position
steering_transfer.scope: held-out transfer of gradient-derived directions on short AIME prefixes; calibration and held-out sites are disjoint per marker; cross cells evaluate a source marker's mean gradient on a target marker's held-out site

steering_sweep.scope: alpha sweep and KL/entropy/other-marker side effects on held-out marker sites; calibration sites build mean g; doses are fractions of block-20 input norm

Use per-marker mean g as the construct, with sparse g as the interpretable variant.

recommendations.reason: The sweep makes the effect/side-effect tradeoff explicit: mean g reaches the largest delta log p but with large KL and entropy drop; sparse g has lower KL at the same dose; w is safest but weaker. Under a mean-KL budget of 0.1 the useful windows differ by marker, so do not use one direction/dose for all markers. Pick the window per marker, then verify side effects on more sites.

warnings: This report is descriptive, not a validated construction recipe. The measured label means the number exists in the source artifact, not that the effect is statistically significant.
Readout (w·U on the marker set) and causal effect (correctness score on held-out multiplication problems) are different targets; do not treat one as evidence for the other.
Block/restore effects are group-level. The unit table is a response ranking, not a causal ranking.
The marker-steering artifact reports selfcheck_passed=false (one Q3 check had no criterion); its readout numbers are usable but its verdict block is not a clean pass.

The readout atlas keeps per-marker rows: best layers and orientations differ across markers (see readout_atlas.per_marker). The set-level AUC must not be used to choose one layer/sign, and small-n markers are not adjudicable.

The construction probe is a local white-box measurement on short AIME prefixes: it compares candidate directions at one alpha, not a general recipe. The first-order unit decomposition is a diagnostic, not a validated mediation percentage.

The held-out transfer has two calibration and two held-out sites per marker; the split is by prefix length, so length/position confounding is possible. Treat the transfer numbers as descriptive, not as a validated recipe.
The alpha sweep has six held-out sites and a single model; KL/entropy are global side effects. High doses can be off-manifold, and the useful window is a descriptive choice under a chosen KL budget.

The compiled recipe verifies on the same held-out sites used by the transfer/sweep, not on a third independent split. The .npy files are local candidate directions, not a validated production steering vector.
headline: Readout is positive for all 7 marker ids, but the measured +v effect on correctness is -0.06641 at the primary dose. Block 20 supports that negative effect; block 25 compensates it. The current vector is a readout direction, not a validated control direction. Hidden-state atlas: best layer 21, raw cos AUC 0.1991, orientation -1 (w·h is anti-aligned with marker positions).
